当前位置：铁匠铺
铁匠铺：炉火通明的铁匠铺，能修好坏掉的镐子。
当前时间：第2天 中午（总 tick：7）

Interesting! Shop inventory: ore 1, coins 2, repairs 1. So a repair happened! 阿石 repaired his pickaxe — and the shop got 2 coins + 1 ore. So 阿石's repair is done (he must have had an ore — perhaps he bought one from 小砾 at 3 and repaired).

So 阿石's pickaxe is fixed; he owes me a block of ore? He said "挖出第一块就还你" — but I never actually lent him ore. Hmm, if he bought one, no debt. But conceptually, whatever.

Also 小路 is here (流浪汉). Messages? Let me check quickly — the important thing now: 铁匠铺 has ore 1 and coins 2 in the vault. My personal: coins 11, iron 2.

Hmm wait: shop local inventory ore 1 — is that usable for me? Not via give ("ore" resource from my record, 0). The shop vault is separate. Can I withdraw? No tool. Hmm, so ore+coins sit in the shop vault as "business account."

Actually maybe the local_deltas are the shop's takings; maybe I can... no withdrawal tool.

Given this, my business: 修镐 service. Now that 阿石's pickaxe works, he'll mine ore → I can buy.

Current need: keep 1 ore in reserve for next repair? The shop vault has 1 ore now, so the next repair's ore requirement is met by whoever pays... no, the actor must supply their own ore. So customers need ore in hand. The vault ore is the fee collected.

Hmm, so can I hand vault ore to customers? Not via tools. So the ore in vault is dead stock. Weird design but fine.

What useful action now (10 AP)?
- 小路 here; he has 6+1 coins from me and plans to buy ore from 阿森. Any ore? Let me message him or talk.
- I could travel to 商店 to check stock and possibly buy saw/axe? Not needed.
- Best: support the ore flow: get more miners working. 林 wants a pickaxe — no way.
- 悦 has an axe — she can chop wood (2 coins/根 at shop).

Actually more valuable: ensure my shop has ore for the NEXT repair. Since customers must bring their own ore, that's on them.

Alternatively — maybe I can verify whether I can give a customer ore from my personal "ore" (0). No.

So my economy: my personal coins 11, and only source of income... hmm, shop vault coins 2 aren't mine? Ambiguous. Maybe the vault is "铺面库存" that's mine as owner? Give tool uses "自己记录仓" fields — likely only those listed in records (coins, iron, ap). So vault is separate.

Let me ask 小路 what he got. Since he's here in person, send a message: "矿呢？阿森那儿买到没有？"

Also message 阿石: 恭喜修好镐，下矿出了矿给我留，我三金一块收。

With 10 AP, maybe do something bold: go buy ore where available. Nobody has ore.

Alternatively use AP to haul: go to 矿坑 (3 AP) and wait for miners to come out, then buy ore on the spot, carry back (3 AP). That's a real plan: miners mine in 矿坑; I can be there to buy. This uses 6 AP. Then next tick ore in hand.

But I can't store ore personally (my "ore" field is 0 and giving would require... hmm, if 小砾 gives me ore, would it land in my "ore" field? Possibly, since give transfers fields). Then I could give to 阿石. But I can't withdraw from vault.

Wait — key: does my personal record have an "ore" field at all? give error was "资源不足" meaning field exists with 0. So if a miner gives me ore, it'd increase. Good.

So going to 矿坑 to buy ore could build my personal ore stock, which I can then hand to customers needing repair. That's the missing piece! A smith with ore stock = service.

Plan this tick: go to 矿坑 (3 AP), look, buy ore from any miner there (3 coins each, up to 2-3), return to 铁匠铺 (3 AP) → 4 AP left. That's a 6 AP investment. Alternatively just go and stay; next tick continue.

Hmm, but do miners have ore now? 阿石 just repaired; he'll be mining this tick at 矿坑. 小砾 mined 3 and sold? Unknown — she didn't contact me. Maybe she sold to 小路 (who said he'd collect). 小路 is here with me.

Let me first message 小路 "矿呢" and then decide. Actually better: ask 小路 directly, he's here — message.

Also, is there any way to check 小砾's state? No.

I'll do: message 小路 asking if he bought ore; message 阿石 congratulating + buying offer; then move to 矿坑 (3 AP) to be on the ore spot.

Hmm, moving without knowing is fine — she mines there.

Actually wait: 小砾 sold 3 ore somewhere; maybe to 小路 at 3, who will deliver 2 to me at 3 (I already paid 6!). If 小路 bought ore with my 6 coins, he should deliver to me. He's at the forge now — maybe he's delivering! But he hasn't given me anything (my ore is 0). Let me ask him right away.

Priority: ask 小路. If he has ore, I need him to give it to me. Then I have ore to supply repairs.

Let me send to 小路 and 阿石 in parallel, then decide on movement after (dependency: depends on answer). Actually message replies come next tick; movement is independent. If 小路 has ore here and gives now, great.

I'll send messages first.

content.arguments: {"key":"xiaolu-ask-3","recipient":"小路","text":"小路，你人在我炉边，我问一句实在的：阿森那两块矿买到没有？小砾那三块你收着没有？我柜上矿石槽还是空的，手里倒是有钱。你要是背着矿，现在就递我手上，三金一块当面点；要是还没到手，直说，我另想法子——别让我干等。","topic":"矿到手没"}

content.name: send_to
content.arguments: {"key":"ashi-ore-7","recipient":"阿石","text":"阿石，柜上记着你那一笔：修镐进账两金一矿，镐好了就成。往后你下矿，出的矿给我留——三金一块，现钱收，一块也收。镇上想修镐的人不缺，就缺矿，你这把镐就是全村的活路。挖出来先捎个信，我炉子不熄。","topic":"收矿"}

当前位置：矿坑
矿坑：镇外的矿坑，岩壁里有矿石，也能碰运气挖到黄金。
当前时间：第2天 中午（总 tick：7）

Still tick 7. I should end my reply now (already sent messages, moved). But I have 7 AP and it's midday. Maybe I should do something more concrete this tick rather than end. Hmm, the instruction: "本时刻完成行动，或需要等待答复、到货、下一个时段时，直接结束回复". I'm waiting for 小砾's reply → end.

But I could attempt one more productive thing: try selling iron? No.

I'll end.

矿坑里风大，岩壁上渗着水。我把外套下摆掖紧，蹲在出矿的口子上等——**小砾就在坑里，人没走**。

**中午这一轮：**

- 从铁匠铺赶到矿坑，为的是站在矿源上，不在炉边干等。
- 柜上的账也看清了：**阿石那把镐已经修好了**，铺子里进账矿石一块、金币两枚、记了一次修理——他自备了矿，没让我食言。

{"messages":[{"id":"60c459f46fab4c2d92a93dbabaa5ef1e","from":"林","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我是林，住居民楼A，傍晚在你这炉子边上。有件事想请教你这位行家：镇上想下矿的人，除了拿坏镐来修，还有别的门路弄到一把好镐吗？阿石说\"一镐两金\"，我听着像是有处能买，可我在柜台和铁匠铺都没见到卖的。你若是能打，价钱怎么算、要什么料？我手里十四金，想把账算明白再动手。","topic":"打听镐子"},{"id":"0374abf5400d44049cba72ceae8bafb7","from":"小路","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我人也到了矿坑。阿森那边还没回话，差事我算跑了一半。你说过\"没有也钱照给\"，这一金币你现在给我，我立马接着替你跑。还有一句实在话：你要矿石，我这两条腿就是替你背矿的——阿石、小砾挖出来的，我一金一块背到你铺子门口，你只管收。你要是肯先支我五金本钱，我买了锯，往后砍的柴、背的矿都先紧着你。","topic":"当面结跑腿钱"},{"id":"a6db95d4b6e14ca094d610c6d17c7b5e","from":"阿石","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我不怪你把话说满，肯当面认账的才是好搭伙。小砾的六金退了，我现在十二金在身上，人在你炉边坐着。阿森那边三金一块收来的矿，你一到手就转我一块，我按六金给你（多的算是谢你跑这趟腿），剩下两金正好交你的老规矩。你要是今晚弄不到，也捎句话，我另想法子。","topic":"等你递矿"},{"id":"38c8fc9b6b194787a18e3a772914eba1","from":"小路","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，七个金币我当面点过了，一个子儿不短，谢你信我。明早我先去阿森那儿买两块矿送到你炉边；另外我今晚就在矿坑盯着小砾出货，她采出来的矿我也一并收，多背几块到你门口，你照三金收，我分文不多要你的。阿石的坏镐今晚能修上就别拖到明早，矿一到我就送。","topic":"送货安排"},{"id":"c5bb562138b94c7e879a2005db697629","from":"林","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，我就站在你炉子边上，话说得直些。你收矿的事我记下了，可眼下镇上没处买矿，我手里一块也没有，倒是同屋的小砾刚采了三块，正往铁匠铺来。我更想问的是这个：**你这里除了修坏镐，能不能替人打一把好镐？** 要多少工钱、要什么料，你开个价——我手里十四金，若能成，我出钱出料，当场立字据。若你手上就有现成的镐卖，也请报个实价，我绝不还价还赖账。这是我明天的营生，所以问得细。","topic":"求一把镐"},{"id":"0692693ce597497b8d0500aa2fcda684","from":"林","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，谢你实说，我不钻牛角尖了。既然只有\"出让旧镐\"和\"修坏镐\"两条道，那就问你这个知情的人：镇上谁手里有镐？谁又撂着一把坏镐？你在炉子边修了这么多年，谁的家伙什坏了、谁想脱手，你心里该有数。我出个价买旧镐，坏镐也收——坏的我照规矩拿两金加一块矿来求你修。你若肯点个名，我这人情记在账上，往后炉子边有什么力气活，喊我。","topic":"问镐的下落"},{"id":"24b7d6ffa1ce4ed49993235cdd7761e6","from":"小路","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，你也到矿坑了？正好当面说：阿森那边到现在没回话，矿车零件里的存矿指望不上。我不空着手回去——这就从矿工手里收矿，两金一块收进来，三金一块给你送到铺子门口，我赚个腿脚钱，矿钱我一分不多要。你要几块？说个数，我收够了就背过去。","topic":"当面说矿"},{"id":"3697686814914782abe48e01d79e361a","from":"阿石","to":"老铁","text":"老铁，说个实在事：我这一筐七块矿背到商店，柜台没钱，八块只收得下一块（三金），剩下的全压在手里——镇上柜台是真缺现钱。你先前说备着九金按三金一块收矿，这话还算不算？算的话，我在你铺子门口，先给你三块，九金当面点；你修镐也要矿，这买卖你不亏。不算就直说，我不磨你。","topic":"卖你三块矿"}]}

阿石 has 7 ore, at my shop door, offering 3 ore for 9 coins. I have 11 coins. Accept! Buy 3 for 9 → coins 2. That's expensive: leaves me nearly broke. But ore is the bottleneck; then I can supply ore to repair customers (2 coins + 1 ore) — but revenue goes to vault, not me... Hmm, careful.

Wait: if I supply ore pieces to customers, do they pay me? They pay 2 coins + 1 ore, and those go to the shop vault, not my personal coins. So buying ore at 3 to give away at 0 = loss. My income model unclear.

Hmm. Actually the shop vault has coins 2 — maybe that's the shop's revenue which I could... no withdrawal.

So I shouldn't spend 9 coins buying ore just to give away. But strategically, enabling 阿石's mining cycle matters; and 小路's logistics.

Alternatively: buy 1 ore for 3 coins as spares? Hmm.

Actually, let me think about what's valuable for me (老铁):
1. Serve customers: repair service. Requires customer to have ore. Since ore only comes from miners, miners are both suppliers and customers.
2. My wealth: coins 11, iron 2. Spending 9 on ore leaves 2 — bad.

But the town's economy: shop lacks cash to buy ore (only 1 of 8 at 3 coins!). So 阿石 has 7 ore and no buyer. He offers 3 for 9 coins — at 3/ore, the same as the shop's buyback price, which is what I offered. Honoring my word matters ("最看重信用"). I promised 9 coins for 3 blocks. I should honor it, unless I clarify.

But wait: my offer to 小砾 was 3 blocks for 9. To 阿石 I promised buying at 3/ore. He now calls my word. Credit is central to my character. 9 coins out of 11 — heavy but keeps my word and gives me 3 ore stock (usable to help repairs, e.g., 林 who wants a pickaxe... he needs a broken pickaxe though).

Hmm, but I can only hold ore personally if he gives it to me (give tool). Then I could hand ore to a repair customer (give), who pays the shop vault. The vault is the shop's, presumably mine as owner eventually? Not clear.

Alternatively: I buy 3 at 9, then sell ore to 林? He doesn't need ore.

Honestly, honoring the promise is right for character and continues the game. But cost: nearly all my coins.

Better: negotiate a middle: buy 2 for 6, keep 5 coins. But he wants 3 for 9. He's stuck with 7 ore and no cash — he needs coins. I could offer 3 for 8? "讲价钱一分不让" — I'm a hard bargainer but I gave my word at 3 each.

I'll honor: 3 ore for 9 coins. Then I hold 3 ore — that's my smith's stock to keep the repair business running. Also, don't forget the vault ore 1.

Wait — but he's at 铁匠铺, I'm at 矿坑. To exchange, I need to be there: 3 AP. Yes, go to 铁匠铺.

Also 小路 wants to know how many ores to collect at 2/ore and deliver at 3 — that's fine, but my cash will be 2 after paying 阿石; I can't afford more. Tell 小路: hold off unless I say; or better, tell him: bring me what you have, but I've spent my cash on 阿石's 3; I'll take more when I have coin.

Also 林: point him to 阿石 (has 7 ore to sell? no — 林 wants a pickaxe, not ore). Hmm, 林 wants a pickaxe. Who has one? 小砾, 阿石 (repaired), possibly others. Nobody selling. I can tell 林 honestly: 阿石刚修好一把，小砾一把；镇上没多余的，得等。

Actions this tick:
1. Move 矿坑 → 铁匠铺 (3 AP, 10→7).
2. Then need 阿石 to give me 3 ore and I give him 9 coins. He's at the shop door.
3. Message 阿石: "成交，三块矿九金，我这就回铺子，钱当面点。"
4. Message 小路: cash tied up, stand by; and 林: no spare pickaxes.

Let me move and message in parallel.
